$comment: The one source of every time limit and threshold in billing: the Worker (control plane and tenant objects), the UI's copy, the emails and the legal terms all read these, and billing/policy.test.mjs plus scripts/check-billing-policy-consumers.mjs prove no consumer carries its own copy. Owner, 2026-10-18: a workspace chooses 'Enable overage billing'; with it on, overage is metered and invoiced and non-payment follows `dunning`; with it off, nothing beyond the quota is ever billed and the service a dimension pays for is terminated `termination_ttl_hours` after the quota is crossed. Every key is required; nothing here is a default.

overage_billing.$comment: Chosen by the workspace's owner at checkout and in billing settings, stored on the tenant row (overage_billing). Free is always off: it has no payment method. Paid creation must name it; the control plane refuses a paid creation that leaves it out.

terminated_service.$comment: What 'terminated' means per dimension, from the moment the TTL runs out until the billing period resets. No data is deleted by a termination (data_deleted_on_termination); deletion happens only through dunning's purge.
terminated_service.relay-overage: Relay is refused: no relay credentials are minted and the object carries no relayed traffic. Direct peer connections, messaging and the workspace itself continue.
terminated_service.document-appends: Documents become read-only: appends are refused, reading and pulling continue.
terminated_service.storage: Uploads are refused at the quota, at once and whatever the toggle: the object holds at most 10 GB, so storage is a hard cap, never an overage.

dunning.$comment: With overage billing on, a failed payment puts the workspace in payment_required: the host refuses connections, the object is not started. Emails go out on reminder_days after the failure; the final warning goes final_warning_hours before the purge at grace_days. Payment restores the workspace at once.

alerts.$comment: When the workspace's admins are told. usage_percent: of the included quota, per dimension, once each per period. overage_step_units: with overage billing on, every this many billed units beyond the quota (GB; thousands of appends). countdown_hours: with it off, this many hours before the termination (0 is the termination itself).

terms.$comment: The terms people accept render these values and, as the owner instructed, say they may change at any time without notice. docs/plans/billing-automation.md section G notes that this clause may be unenforceable for consumers in some jurisdictions and recommends legal review.
